title: Verify the signature of a selected .NET base image
goal: Verify a selected container image index and platform digest against an explicit signer and strict trust policy before using it as an application base.

selectionNotes: Only target11 is advertised; the actual .NET10 comparison adds no ninth foundation. Existing recipe/edition identities and PIN-959/PIN-963/Human gates are preserved.
Azure Linux4 remains Beta under the reviewed official source. Exact RC2 execution is not actual-GA qualification.
Signature/referrer inspection is not verification. Valid signing proves provenance under this policy, not vulnerability freedom, support or application compatibility.
The selected .NET10 image already carries signatures. Verify both image index and selected linux/amd64 child; immutable digests and strict scope/identity are required.
No system trust-store or ordinary Notation configuration is edited. The HTTP exception is only for an ephemeral loopback registry rejection fixture.

Notation1.3.2; ORAS1.3.6 helper; exact Microsoft signing/TSA roots and strict policy, all hashes retained in the sample. Public certificate/registry access for setup and verification.
